description: Course material · PDF pp. 8–9, 17–21, 24–30, 36–37. Eurobarometer charts in this deck are historical; personal values and values associated with the EU are different questions.

title: Frischhut — European Health Union workshop (2026/27)
description: Course material · PDF pp. 3–10, 12–13, 17–26. The deck mixes historical developments, existing measures and reform proposals. These categories are kept separate here.

title: Enthoven & van de Ven — Going Dutch (2007)
description: Assigned reading · NEJM 357:2421–2423; supplied PDF pp. 1–3. Historical perspective article. Numbers and policy arrangements refer to its publication period, not to 2026.

title: van de Ven & Schut — Universal mandatory health insurance with managed competition (2008 draft)
description: Assigned reading · Revised 24 January 2008; supplied PDF pp. 3–16. Historical working paper supplied for the course; forecasts in the paper remain forecasts, not verified subsequent outcomes.

title: van de Ven, van Kleef & van Vliet — Risk selection threatens quality of care (2015)
description: Assigned reading · Health Affairs 34:1713–1720; supplied PDF pp. 2–8. Historical analysis of selection incentives. Full article is not redistributed; access may require your library.

title: Hagen & Feiring — Health Policy Reforms for Three Decades: Then Returning to Square One? (2025)
description: Assigned reading · Oxford Handbook of Norwegian Politics, ch. 31; supplied PDF pp. 2–10. An analysis of reforms and priority setting, not a complete national health-system manual. Author interpretations are identified as such.

title: De Belvis et al. — Italy: Health System Summary (2024)
description: Assigned reading · Supplied PDF pp. 3–7, 10–20. Source snapshot with information available in September 2024. Read the original via the course. Original explanations here; no figures or PDF republished.

title: Bachner et al. — Austria: Health System Summary (2024)
description: Assigned reading · Supplied PDF pp. 3–7, 10–16, 20–21. Source snapshot with information available in September 2024. No report figures or PDF republished.

title: OECD/European Observatory — Austria: Country Health Profile (2025)
description: Assigned reading · Supplied PDF pp. 2–3, 9–10, 14–22. Finalised September 2025; indicators use several underlying years. Not a live 2026 dashboard.

title: Council conclusions: Common values and principles in EU health systems (2006)
description: Workshop pre-reading · OJ C 146, 22 June 2006, pp. 1–3. Non-binding Council conclusions, not an EU regulation. Public primary source.

title: Manifesto for a European Health Union
description: Workshop pre-reading · Manifesto linked by the lecturer. An advocacy document for critical discussion, not binding law. Signing is optional and is not part of this Hub activity.

title: EU Charter: Article 35 — Health care
description: Supplementary primary source · Article 35 and explanations. Public reference checked 8 October 2026. National conditions and the Charter’s scope matter.

title: European Commission — Health care and the Charter’s scope
description: Supplementary primary source · Know your rights / what to do. Clarifies that national authorities are bound by the Charter when implementing EU law. Not an expansion of course exam scope.

title: Belgian FPS Public Health — Reimbursement under European regulations
description: Supplementary primary source · EHIC and S2 sections. Public authority explanation checked 8 October 2026; Belgian procedural context. Used only to clarify the different routes, not individual eligibility.

title: Italian Ministry of Health — Urgent and necessary treatment in Italy
description: Supplementary primary source · Restrictions on use of the EHIC. Public authority explanation: EHIC is not a route for travel whose purpose is planned treatment; public-system affiliation matters.

title: Greer et al. — Everything you always wanted to know about EU health policy (4th ed., 2024)
description: Reading map · Economic rights: pp. 126–152 and 158–169; Human rights: pp. 123–124; Values: pp. 123–126. Page assignments transcribed from Organizational issues p. 13. The complete book has not been reviewed for this edition.

title: Frischhut — What one should know about the European Union (5th ed., 2026)
description: Reading map · Non-discrimination: pp. 62–65 and 75–76; foundations: pp. 9–28, 36–37, 43–67. Bibliographic details and assignments from the lecturer. Full book not supplied; availability not independently verified.

title: Frischhut — The Ethical Spirit of EU Law (2019)
description: Reading map · Assigned pp. 21–29 and 34–36. Marked open access in the organizational slides. Link only; full book is not part of the source review.

title: Di Federico (ed.) — Lineamenti di diritto sanitario europeo
description: Further reading · Italian-language reading listed in the course notice. Listed by the lecturer as 2026 and open access. Publisher page could not be independently retrieved; publication details remain as supplied.
